note: The Plumb constant lint walks files and cannot see a cfg(test) attribute carried on a mod declared with a path attribute in ANOTHER file. windows/vessel/src/liveness_tests/emitter_scan.rs is an in-crate test module included that way from liveness.rs; the lint prunes tests/ directories and reads each files own attributes, so the modules test-only status is invisible and its two synthetic fixture constants were refused as though they were world values. The Detent tagged them plumb: universal(...) with honest reason text and a declared axis that misstates what they are, and the committed roster denominator moved 686 to 688 while test-only exclusions stayed at 166. The fix is Plumb-side: resolve the path attribute before deciding a files test-only status. Also note a wrapped tag parses as malformed, so these have to be one line.
